 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY  
Heightened global tensions with multiple high-risk incidents. Key concerns include systemic aviation vulnerabilities in the US, escalating conflict-related targeting in Ukraine/Russia, and mass-casualty violence in Sudan. Civil unrest in Brussels and a terror attack in Sydney also demand attention.

 KEY INCIDENTS  
- US Congress advancing military draft preparations, signaling potential future conflict escalation.  
- Systemic failures admitted in DCA aviation crash, revealing military-civilian coordination gaps.  
- Ukrainian drone strikes targeting Russian refinery and cargo vessel, with fatalities reported.  
- Over 1,000 killed in RSF paramilitary attack on Sudanese refugee camp amid aid reduction crisis.  
- Active shooter terror attack in Sydney shopping center, with civilian casualties.

✈️ AVIATION/OPS IMPACT  
Multiple aviation incidents: crashes in Chicago and Nashua under investigation; no confirmed malicious intent but operational disruptions likely. Military-civilian coordination flaws highlighted in DC-area crash may affect future airspace procedures.

 OUTLOOK  
Expect continued kinetic escalation in Ukraine conflict, with energy infrastructure and maritime assets at risk. Geopolitical tensions may rise with reported US-Israel Iran strike planning. Monitor Sudan for further humanitarian collapse and Brussels for protest-related disruptions. Aviation safety reviews probable in US following recent incidents.
